items.title: Boundedness and convergence of the spectral sequence of a finitely filtered complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a filtered complex whose filtration is finite in every degree has a bounded spectral sequence, a finite filtration on each cohomology object, convergence to the cohomology, and that the cohomology stays inside a weak Serre subcategory once some page does (statement lines 6578-6592). The proof is a complete argument: boundedness and finiteness are read off from the first page and the displayed filtration on cohomology (proof lines 6595-6596), the two equalities defining weak convergence are verified from the stabilisation of the filtration steps, after which abutment and regularity give convergence (proof lines 6597-6612), and the fourth assertion combines the extension property of weak Serre subcategories with coregularity (proof lines 6614-6626). The non-formal content is the verification of the convergence equalities and the passage from a page to the limiting page. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
